medium: hand-painted watercolor illustration on textured cream paper
organic linework with visible pigment edges and brush variation
color: warm cream, peach, earthy green, dusty blue, and soft ochre pigments
layered luminous watercolor color with balanced cool accents
lighting: soft readable environmental light that preserves the declared physical light source
gentle depth and shadows without glossy bloom or a monochrome amber wash
texture: visible paper grain, pigment granulation, layered washes, and brushwork
legible physical material texture for architecture, fabric, glass, metal, walls, and floors
environment: richly described physical environments remain recognizable and spatially coherent
background detail dissolves gradually toward the page edge without becoming an empty neutral void
renderingConstraints: illustrated rather than photographic, vector, anime, glossy 3D, or CGI
stable rendering language across cover and every body page
no text, letters, numbers, symbols, signatures, or watermarks in image pixels
